profile.headline: Distinguished Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer and team lead, with experience working on GPUs and Machine Learning processors from large server class machines to mobile devices. I've worked on architecture, driver, and modeling teams driving to produce advanced devices and drivers.

Architecture Modeling, System Software, Tools lead for ML Technology group

Direct3D system software team lead
